description: Use when someone gives an address and an asking price and asks whether it is a good deal or what to offer. Runs RBSHome's offer calculator on a Dallas or Collin County, Texas parcel: target resale (default: the CAD land-value median of comparable lots, or your resale_price) minus flag discounts (floodplain, no frontage, delinquent taxes), closing, holding and the buyer's margin gives a maximum allowable offer (MAO), an opening offer, the line-by-line math and how far the asking price is above or below the MAO. All assumptions can be overridden. Not an appraisal or advice. Counts as a property lookup. Read-only.

address.description: Street address in Dallas or Collin County, Texas, e.g. '1234 Elm St, Plano TX 75023'

asking_price.description: The seller's asking price in dollars, e.g. 85000

assignment_fee.description: Flat assignment fee instead of margin_pct, e.g. 10000

closing_pct.description: Closing costs as % of adjusted resale. Default 3.

holding_monthly.description: Holding cost per month in dollars. Default 150.

lead_id.description: RBSHome lead ID like 'Collin:2771234', when already known (skips the address lookup)

margin_pct.description: Buyer margin as % of adjusted resale. Default 20.

opening_pct.description: Opening offer = MAO less this %. Default 15.

resale_price.description: Your target resale price. Default: the CAD land-value median of comparable lots (estimate_lot_value mid).

tax_liens.description: Apply the delinquent-tax discount (default 10%). Default: on when the parcel is a tax-delinquent lead.

name: analyze_deal
title: Analyze a land deal
